# Github-Quick-Launcher

Quickly access your GitHub repositories and stars from Flow Launcher

[![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/Garulf/Github-Quick-Launcher/ci.yml)](https://github.com/Garulf/Github-Quick-Launcher/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Garulf/Github-Quick-Launcher)](https://github.com/Garulf/Github-Quick-Launcher/releases/latest)

## Install

In Flow Launcher, run:

```
pm install github quick launcher
```

## Usage

The default action keyword is `gr`.

| Query | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `gr flow launcher` | Search all of GitHub. Your own matching repositories are listed first. |
| `gr /` | List your repositories, most recently updated first. |
| `gr /dot` | Filter your repositories. |
| `gr *` or `gr *py` | List or filter your starred repositories. |
| `gr torvalds/` or `gr torvalds/lin` | Search another user's repositories. |
| `gr !refresh` | Fetch your repositories and stars again right now. |

### Your repositories

![A bare slash lists your own repositories](docs/screenshots/own-light.png#gh-light-mode-only)![A bare slash lists your own repositories](docs/screenshots/own-dark.png#gh-dark-mode-only)

`/` needs to know who you are. Set either option in the plugin settings:

| Setting | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GitHub username | empty | Lists that account's public repositories and stars. No token needed. |
| Personal access token | empty | Adds private repositories and raises the API rate limit. No scopes are required; allow `read:org` to include organization repositories. |
| Cache lifetime (minutes) | 10 | How long the repository list is reused before it is refreshed in the background. |

### Context menu

Press Shift+Enter or right-click a repository to open it in GitHub Desktop or VS Code, or to copy its name, URL, or a clone command.

![Repository context menu](docs/screenshots/context-light.png#gh-light-mode-only)![Repository context menu](docs/screenshots/context-dark.png#gh-dark-mode-only)

## Speed

Your repositories and stars are kept in memory and on disk, so `/` and `*` answer instantly, even right after Flow Launcher starts. The list refreshes in the background once it is older than the cache lifetime, using conditional requests that do not count against GitHub's rate limit when nothing changed.
